title: Console first load: the English language pack is again at its size ceiling, so five queue builds failed `Build & E2E UI` by 0.1 KB in an hour (recurrence of #30588)
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ① a measured, recurring red. Five merge-queue builds failed the same gate in the hour after 11:30Z. ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: while `i18n-locale-en` sits on its ceiling, every PR that adds any English console text is ejected from the queue. Today that hit five unrelated PRs, and each ejection costs a queue rebuild for the entries behind it. The gate's own text forbids widening the ceiling to get green, so the fix is to move bytes off the eager path, as #30588 did.
Reader: the `domain:ui` seat (`ui/packages/i18n`, the console's first-load chunking).
Dedupe (open and closed): `i18n-locale-en`. Only #30588 (closed 2026-11-06 by PR #30640, which moved `marketplace.*` to a lazy namespace) is on point, and this is its recurrence. **New.**
class: c · type: Bug

## 维护者速读

控制台首屏的英文语言包又顶到体积上限了：这一小时里有 5 个 PR 因为多了 0.1 KB 被合并队列踢出。上次（#30588）的修法是把首屏用不到的 `marketplace` 文案拆成懒加载命名空间；这次照同样方式再拆一块。规则写明不要直接抬高上限。

## Readings

All are from `Build & E2E UI` → `pnpm --dir ui check:eager-closure`:

| Queue run | PR | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| 42813321927 | #32050 | `❌ i18n-locale-en 60.6 KB / 60.5 KB ceiling (OVER by 0.1 KB)` |
| 42813327653 | #32172 | same |
| 42816108276 | #32124 | same |
| (12:27Z run) | #32184 | failure, same job |
| 42816602751 | #32195 | same, job 129832229737 |

- Builds that added no English text passed in the same window (#32028, #32034, #32039 and others), so `main` itself is under the ceiling. It is not a `main` red.
- Each failing PR adds a few English keys, and that alone crosses the line.

## What to build

1. **Step 0:** measure `i18n-locale-en`'s gzip bytes on `main`, and list its largest top-level subtrees with their first-load use. The `check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` caveat in #30588 still applies: `_one` and `_other` plural forms are live.
2. Move one or more first-load-unused subtrees into lazy namespaces, the way `studio` and `marketplace` are (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/*`, with its own `i18n-ns-*` vite group). Every locale moves with it.
3. Leave real headroom: at least several KB. State the new reading in the PR.
4. ⛔ Do not raise `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS['i18n-locale-en']`. The script says a raise is a deliberate, maintainer-visible decision.

## Done when

`main`'s `i18n-locale-en` has several KB of headroom, and the five PRs above pass the gate on a rebase without trimming their own text.

Grade: p1. It is a repeated queue red that ejects unrelated PRs.
